name: Copenhagen Sakura Festival 2021 - Online
description:
We’re excited to announce the Copenhagen Sakura Festival 2021 - ONLINE EDITION! 🤩
Make sure you tune in via our website on April 17th at 12.00 (GMT+2) https://sakurafestival.dk/

-----
Unfortunately, due to the current COVID-19 situation, we won't be able to meet up at Langelinie as previous years of Copenhagen Sakura Festival. Therefore, the 2021 Edition of the festival will be held online 📹 💻

At sakurafestival.dk we will premiere a unique video version of the festival, where you will be able to attend live from anywhere! 🌍

The main program will feature Japanese culture, martial arts, music, artistic performances and much more. Besides, the festival will host several video performances from festival attendees, organizations and companies connected to the festival, if you want to get the most complete virtual Sakura Festival experience 🌸

ℹ The main program will be premiered live on April 17th at 12.00 (GMT+2) on sakurafestival.dk  ℹ

If you are not able to attend the premiere - don't worry! After the premiere, you will be able to view the festival program and all other featured videos on demand, at any time you'd like :)

We look forward to seeing you at this very special and hopefully once-in-a-lifetime experience ^_^
